g.text: BREAKING: ASHWIN KUMAR K IS OPEN FOR FREELANCE PROJECTS, INTERNSHIPS & COLLABORATIONS ◆ NOW LIVE: KRAFT, A REMARKABLE SURPRISE - BIRTHDAY WEBSITES WHERE YOU BLOW OUT THE CANDLES WITH YOUR REAL MIC ◆ OPEN SOURCE: MACROBOARD LETS ANYONE CONFIGURE ESP ACCESSIBILITY BOARDS WITH ZERO CODE ◆ HARDWARE: THE E-WASTE COLLECTOR WEIGHS YOUR E-WASTE AND PAYS YOU VIA UPI FOR THE WEIGHT AND THE COMPONENTS INSIDE ◆ HEALTH-TECH: NEUROSCAN AI READS BRAIN CT SCANS - ISCHEMIA, BLEEDING OR NORMAL ◆ WEARABLE: EASYG STREAMS ECG FROM ESP32 + AD8232 WITH ML ANOMALY DETECTION ◆ CREATIVE-TECH: AI VIRTUAL PAINTER DRAWS WITH HAND GESTURES AND SOLVES MATH FROM SCREENSHOTS VIA GEMINI ◆ SHIPPED: RHEALTHCITY, SAESPARTNER AND THE VEERA PRODUCT CATALOG ARE LIVE ON THE WEB ◆ CERTIFIED: AWS MACHINE LEARNING FOR NLP + MONGODB DEVELOPER TRACK ◆ CAMPUS: CSE (AI & ML) AT RAJALAKSHMI INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, CHENNAI ◆
